programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: Beauty On and Off
programme.desc: K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing. So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products. Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”. Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: TALK ROOM
programme.desc: What is the true strength of the K-people leading the K-Wave? We invite the most talked-about figures—those who influence not just Korea but the world—into our studio for intimate one-on-one conversations. Through their stories, the secrets behind overcoming failure and achieving success, and even private small talk, we uncover what makes them extraordinary. When you listen to someone’s story, you enter their world. In this time of dialogue with the most Korean yet most global K-people, we step into the K-Universe.

programme.title: WITH SCIENCE, WE LIVE

programme.title: Arirang Special
programme.desc: Arirang Special features a variety of unique and special programs produced by Arirang TV. These exciting programs will open your eyes to a new part of the world.

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. programme.title: Dashcam Justice
programme.desc: A van overtakes a double-decker bus, then swerves towards a rider’s horses to avoid an oncoming car. Her head camera captures the frightening near miss, and police uncover a surprising detail about the driver. An insurer suspects a moped rider is engineering a crash for cash, while on Bristol's M32, a motorist cuts in and slams on the brakes, endangering the lives of other drivers.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: It's a labour of love for two brothers who create a wonderful home for their sister in Chesterton, while Martin is puzzled by a door leading nowhere in Plymouth and Dion follows a speedy flat renovation in Wales.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Caroline Hawley is on the hunt for hats in Yorkshire. In Leeds, she admires a collection of miniature items created by 19th-century hatter John Craig. These bijou bonnets, bowlers and top hats are tiny replicas of the real thing and demonstrated the maker’s skill and expertise. Hoping to get ahead on the show are two teams of antique hunters. Diagnosing a win are doctors and married couple Gareth and Linda, but can they buy and sell as well as retailers Natalie and Steph? With Philip Serrell by their side, the medics spot what looks like a Gladstone bag. It’s not an open and shut case though, so they move on. Over with the blues, expert Jonathan Pratt picks up a miner’s yardstick, but having got the measure of it, he puts the stick on the back burner. Ultimately, their fate lies in the hands of Ripon auctioneer David Elstob and the bidders in the saleroom!

programme.title: BBC News at One

programme.title: Scam Interceptors
programme.desc: The team try to track down a woman being targeted by a skilful scammer posing as Sky broadband, who claims to be helping fix a problem with her internet connection. In reality, he is using the ruse to gain full control of her phone and buy himself gift cards. As Nick and Harleen struggle to get through, they look into other options. Will the locals of Margate be willing to help the woman before the scammer gets his hands on her money?

programme.title: Doorbell Detectives
programme.desc: Matt Allwright hears from Ann, who woke up to find she’d been robbed while she was asleep, but other doorbell detectives hold the crucial evidence to bring them to justice. Former police inspector Anton Sullivan gives some top tips on how to protect your home when you’re away. And Matt also hears from a teenage hero whose camera captured the moment he rescued an elderly lady from a burning building.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: After a few decades in Australia, today’s house-hunting couple now want to swap surf and sunshine down under for a new adventure in Cornwall. Jules Hudson helps them on their quest for a home with views and Cornish charm. He also visits an abandoned slate quarry that has been transformed into an extraordinary off-grid retreat, full of creativity and coastal magic.

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road

The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the £5,000 cash prize.

programme.title: Farm 999
programme.desc: In Cambridgeshire, the East Anglian air ambulance races to save farmer Jonathan Willis after a freak accident leaves him impaled on his forklift. When the crew arrive, they realise one wrong move could prove fatal. The rescue is complex and high risk, with medics battling to stabilise Jonathan in the middle of his own yard, before rushing him to a specialist major trauma unit. Featuring dramatic CCTV footage of the incident and first-hand accounts from Jonathan, his wife Wendy and paramedic Andy Bates, this is an extraordinary story of split-second decisions and sheer determination in the fight to save a life. Meanwhile, in the Scottish Highlands, farmers face devastating attacks on their lambs by white-tailed eagles, threatening livelihoods and sparking debate over how to protect flocks. And in Cheshire, reporter Paul Colgan joins police tackling the surge in illegal fly-tipping, exposing how organised gangs are blighting farmland across the region.

programme.title: Cheers: Sams dumme Frauen
programme.desc: Diane ist eifersüchtig auf all die dummen jungen Frauen, mit denen Sam im steten Wechsel aufkreuzt. Sie macht ihm ein schlechtes Gewissen, weil er sich mit keiner intelligenten Frau einlässt.

programme.title: Cheers: Wer ist hier das Ekel?
programme.desc: Ein Gast fühlt sich von Carla angepöbelt und beschwert sich. Nur wenn sie ihre Aggressionen therapieren lässt, will er auf eine Klage verzichten. Der Psychologe verpasst Carla eine völlig neue Identität. Jetzt ist sie fromm wie ein Lamm.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Lückenbüßer
programme.desc: Sam soll fürs Fernsehen interviewt werden und aus seiner Sportlervergangenheit erzählen. Als der Reporter jedoch einen ganz bekannten Sportstar vor die Kamera bekommt, lässt er Sam einfach fallen. Der Lückenbüßer ist am Boden zerstört.

programme.title: Cheers: Verlobt mit einem Schwein
programme.desc: Zur großen Freude des Coachs kommt Tochter Lisa zu Besuch, um ihren Verlobten vorzustellen. Dieser Verlobte, ein gewisser Roy, macht aber den denkbar miesesten Eindruck: Er ist ein Ekel von Mensch.

programme.title: Cheers: Abenteuer am Nachmittag
programme.desc: Eine altjüngferliche Studienfreundin von Diane sehnt sich nach einem richtigen Mann. Sie kommt im Cheers vorbei. Natürlich fällt ihr begehrlicher Blick auf Sam, das Prachtexemplar.

programme.title: Cheers: Die Buchhalterparty
programme.desc: Norm hat einen undankbaren Job. Er muss für seine Firma die jährliche Party organisieren. Er mietet das Cheers an und gibt das Motto ,,Toga-Party wie im alten Rom" aus. Leider ist er der einzige, der dieses Motto auch ernst nimmt.

programme.title: Cheers: Gute Freundinnen
programme.desc: Die beiden Kellnerinnen im Cheers, Carla und Diane, sind in Hassliebe verbunden. Sam rät ihnen zu einem klärenden Gespräch. Die beiden Frauen bleiben nach Dienstschluß noch im Cheers, um zu reden. Carlas selbstgemixter Cocktail wirkt dabei Wunder.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Coach greift an
programme.desc: Der Coach hat eine bezaubernde Untermieterin. Nach dem Willen von Carla und Diane soll er die junge Frau sofort anflirten. Zunächst hat er wenig Erfolg bei ihr. Schließlich fällt ihm noch ein alter Aufreißertrick ein.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Glücksbringer
programme.desc: Sam trägt als Glücksbringer einen alten Kronkorken mit sich herum. Widerstrebend leiht er den Talisman einem Baseballspieler. Anschließend gerät Sam selbst in eine tiefe Krise.

programme.title: Cheers: Dianes Zitatenschatz
programme.desc: Diane sammelt Bonmots von allen möglichen Leuten im Cheers. Alle werden in ihrem Zitatenschatz verewigt. Nur der arme Sam ist wieder mal nicht schlau genug, den passenden Spruch parat zu haben.

programme.title: Cheers: Dichter oder Spion?
programme.desc: Ein ungewöhnlicher Gast im Cheers will zuerst Spion, dann Dichter von Beruf sein. Niemand glaubt ihm. Schließlich erzählt er allen, er sei Multimillionär. Auch damit findet er kein Gehör.

programme.title: Cheers: Keine Liebe, keine Werbung
programme.desc: Eine attraktive Werbefrau in mittleren Jahren verspricht Sam lukrative Fernsehspots. Das Angebot gilt nur, wenn er sich auch sonst ihr gegenüber nicht abweisend zeigt. Sam geht auf ihre Forderungen ein.

programme.title: Cheers: Geteilter Kummer
programme.desc: Diane bekommt einen Anruf von ihren Eltern. Sie muss voller Schmerz erfahren, dass ihre Katze gestorben ist. Sie erzählt allen von dem Unglück. Aber weder die Stammgäste noch ihre Kollegen wollen den Kummer mit ihr teilen.

programme.title: Cheers: Männer sind doch alle Schrott...
programme.desc: Carla ist schwanger. Die Überraschung im Cheers ist groß. Carlas Kollegen sind völlig aus dem Häuschen, als sie erfahren, wer der Vater ist: ein unscheinbarer Gelehrtentyp.

programme.title: Cheers: Unsere Bar soll sauber bleiben!
programme.desc: Die Stammbesetzung im Cheers hegt Befürchtungen, die Bar könnte zu einem Schwulentreff werden. Sofort beginnt ein hässliches Gestichel gegen Gäste, die man für homosexuell hält.

programme.title: Cheers: Das ideale Rendezvous
programme.desc: Sam und Diane denken sich ein Spielchen aus: Jeder soll dem anderen den idealen Partner zum Rendezvous herbeischaffen. Diane nimmt die Abmachung ernst und besorgt eine herbe Schönheit.

programme.title: Cheers: Bostons beste Bedienung
programme.desc: Der alljährliche Kellnerinnen-Wettbewerb der Stadt findet dieses Jahr im Cheers statt. Sam hat Diane dafür angemeldet – allerdings ohne ihr Wissen.

programme.title: Cheers: Der betrogene Betrüger
programme.desc: Der allzu vertrauensselige Coach hat 8.000 Dollar an einen Berufsspieler verloren. Sam und seine Stammbesetzung im Cheers lassen sich etwas einfallen. Sie wollen den Betrüger aufs Kreuz legen.

programme.title: Cheers: Trauung am Tresen
programme.desc: Dianes Mutter kommt zu Besuch. Der Grund: Es gibt eine Klausel im Testament ihres verstorbenen Gatten. Die besagt, dass Tochter Diane umgehend verheiratet werden muss. Als Zukünftiger bietet sich Sam an.

programme.title: Cheers: Ein Halbgott als Bruder
programme.desc: Sams Bruder Derek kommt auf Besuch ins Cheers. Er ist derjenige von beiden, der immer alles besser konnte. Folgerichtig hat er auch Diane sofort um den Finger gewickelt.

programme.title: Cheers: Hau ab und bleib hier!
programme.desc: Es scheint, als hätte Sam seine Chancen bei Diane verspielt. Sie hat sich offenbar für seinen Bruder Derek entschieden. Bevor sie ganz zu ihm geht, sucht sie eine letzte Auseinandersetzung mit Sam.

programme.title: Revenant Zmrtvýchvstání
programme.desc: Velkolepý snímek REVENANT Zmrtvýchvstání vzdává hold neobyčejné síle lidského ducha a nabízí strhující divácký zážitek. Legendární lovec a dobrodruh Hugh Glass (Leonardo DiCaprio) je během výpravy v americké divočině brutálně napaden medvědem a zanechán napospas smrti zbylými členy své lovecké skupiny. V neúnavné snaze přežít a najít vykoupení Glass přetrpí nepředstavitelný smutek, stejně jako zradu od svého souputníka Johna Fitzgeralda (Tom Hardy). Jedinou zbraní mu je nezlomná vůle a láska k rodině, díky níž se Glass pouští do boje s krutou zimou v zatím nezmapované krajině. Tento film, inspirovaný skutečným příběhem, získal tři Oscary: za nejlepší režii, kameru a pro herce v hlavní roli Leonarda DiCapria.

programme.title: Ve vazbě

programme.title: Šifra mistra Leonarda
programme.desc: Světový bestseller Dana Browna s názvem Šifra mistra Leonarda přichází ve filmové podobě režiséra Rona Howarda. Symbololog Robert Langdon (Tom Hanks) je zapleten do záhadné a bizarní vraždy. Po svém boku má vnučku oběti a kryptoložku Sophii Neveuovou (Audrey Tautouová), která společně s Robertem objeví stopy obsažené v Da Vinciho obrazech. Ve snaze rozklíčovat celou pravdu se Robert se Sophií vydají z Paříže do Londýna a cestou potkají nejen spojence, ale i darebáky jako jsou Sir Leigh Teabing (Ian McKellen) a Silas (Paul Bettany). Ať už je kroky zavedou kamkoli, tajemství, které má vyplout na povrch, by mohlo otřást základy křesťanství.

programme.title: Interstellar
programme.desc: Píše se rok 2061. Zemi sužuje sucho a hladomor, docházejí základní potraviny a planeta čelí prudkým změnám klimatu. Lidské rase hrozí vyhynutí. Tomu by však mohl zabránit záhadný objev v oblasti výzkumu časoprostoru, díky kterému má lidstvo možná šanci na záchranu. Skupina vědců se musí vydat mimo naši sluneční soustavu a pokusit se najít pro lidské pokolení planetu, na které bude moci žít. Posádka lodi Endurance míří do mezigalaktického neznáma, do míst, kam se ještě nikdo před nimi nedostal. Pilota Coopa čeká zásadní rozhodnutí - bude muset volit mezi tím, zda ještě uvidí své děti, nebo se pokusí zachránit budoucnost lidstva.

programme.title: Respect: Královna soulu
programme.desc: Film vypráví výjimečný příběh životní cesty legendární hudební hvězdy Arethy Franklin. Svůj hlas musela prosadit v nesnadných 60. letech minulého století, kdy se Amerika ocitla uprostřed bouřlivého sociálního a politického dění. Výběr herečky, která ji měla ztvárnit ve filmu, schválila ještě samotná pěvecká legenda. Kromě držitelky Oscara Jennifer Hudson (2007, nejlepší herečka ve vedlejší roli "Dreamgirls"), se ve hvězdně obsazeném životopisném snímku představí i držitel Oscara Forest Whitaker (2007, nejlepší herec "Poslední skotský král"), zpěvačka Mary J. Blige či Marlon Wayans.

programme.title: Zatím spolu, zatím živi
programme.desc: V akční komedii je Tom Cruise tajným agentem a Cameron Diaz ženou polapenou mezi ním a těmi, kteří ho - podle jeho tvrzení - do této situace dostali. S tím, jak se jejich divoké dobrodružství mění v bludiště podfuků, úniků na poslední chvíli, falešných identit a opojných romantických, ale naprosto zmatených situací, zjišťují, že jediné, na co se mohou spoléhat, jsou oni dva navzájem. Dvojici hvězdných představitelů doplňují ve vedlejších rolích Paul Dano (Až na krev, Malá Miss Sunshine), Viola Davis (Pochyby) či Peter Sarsgaard (Škola života).

programme.title: Zatím spolu, zatím živi
programme.desc: V akční komedii je Tom Cruise tajným agentem a Cameron Diaz ženou polapenou mezi ním a těmi, kteří ho - podle jeho tvrzení - do této situace dostali. S tím, jak se jejich divoké dobrodružství mění v bludiště podfuků, úniků na poslední chvíli, falešných identit a opojných romantických, ale naprosto zmatených situací, zjišťují, že jediné, na co se mohou spoléhat, jsou oni dva navzájem. Dvojici hvězdných představitelů doplňují ve vedlejších rolích Paul Dano (Až na krev, Malá Miss Sunshine), Viola Davis (Pochyby) či Peter Sarsgaard (Škola života).

programme.title: Generace Matrix
programme.desc: V roce 1999 šokoval celou generaci jedinečný film, který si získal obrovskou popularitu. Zrodila se sága Matrix, která se rychle stala popkulturním fenoménem filmařské dvojice Wachowských. Prorocké aspekty této produkce se staly ústředním tématem dokumentu. Snímek, který diváka vtáhl do 21. století, předjímal mnohé společenské a politické problémy naší doby: využívání technologií, hackerství, genderové záležitosti a otázky identity, falešné zprávy a konspirační teorie.

Kromě držitelky Oscara Jennifer Hudson (2007, nejlepší herečka ve vedlejší roli "Dreamgirls"), se ve hvězdně obsazeném životopisném snímku představí i držitel Oscara Forest Whitaker (2007, nejlepší herec "Poslední skotský král"), zpěvačka Mary J. Blige či Marlon Wayans.

programme.title: Steve Jobs
programme.desc: Snímek "Steve Jobs" se odehrává na pozadí uvedení tří legendárních produktů na trh a končí v roce 1998, kdy byl představen počítač iMac. Zavádí nás do zákulisí digitální revoluce a vykresluje intimní portrét geniálního muže, který stál v jejím středu. Režisérem filmu je oscarový Danny Boyle a scénář napsal držitel Oscara Aaron Sorkin na základě bestsellerového životopisu zakladatele společnosti Apple od Waltera Isaacsona. Michael Fassbender hraje Steva Jobse, průkopnického zakladatele společnosti Apple, a v hlavní roli Joanny Hoffmanové, bývalé marketingové šéfky společnosti Macintosh, se představuje držitelka Oscara® Kate Winsletová. Spoluzakladatele společnosti Apple Steva Wozniaka hraje Seth Rogen a Jeff Daniels vystupuje jako bývalý generální ředitel Applu John Sculley.

programme.title: Ex Machina
programme.desc: Caleb Smith (Domhnall Gleeson), šestadvacetiletý programátor největší internetové společnosti na světě, vyhraje soutěž o týdenní pobyt na soukromém horském sídle geniálního a samotářského ředitele společnosti Nathana Batemana (Oscar Isaac). Když však Caleb dorazí na odlehlé místo, zjistí, že se bude muset zúčastnit podivného a fascinujícího experimentu, v němž je nucen komunikovat s první skutečnou umělou inteligencí na světě, umístěnou v těle krásné robotické dívky Avy (Alicia Vikanderová).

programme.desc: S02E05 Protože Ziggy dluží dealerům za drogy, seberou mu jeho milované auto - červené Camaro. Plukovník Rawls ujistí Bunkse, že ho nechce stáhnout z případu, přestože se vražda nedaří vyšetřit. Bodie řeší potyčku v Pitu kvůli nekvalitním drogám. Detektivové předávají přístavním dělníkům předvolání kvůli místní vraždě. Policajtka Beadie Russellová využívá bývalé náklonnosti jednoho z dělníků a pokouší se zjistit, jak se náklad dostal z přístavu. Objeví se požadavek na spojení případu vraždy s vyšetřováním Franka Sobotky a jeho kolegů z odborů.

programme.title: Rocky IV
programme.desc: Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) pyšně vévodí světovém šampionátu v těžké váze, ale na obzoru se objevuje nový vyzyvatel: Drago (Dolph Lundgren) - skoro dva metry vysoký a 118 kilogramů vážící bojovník, za nímž stojí celý Sovětský svaz. Rocky se za tréninkem vydává až na mrazivou Sibiř, kde se připravuje na zápas, který se odehraje v samotném srdci Moskvy a bude vysílán po celém světě. Ale nic ho nedokáže připravit na to, čemu bude muset čelit ve skutečnosti. Čeká ho krutý boj od začátku až do úplného konce, ve kterém se nebude bít jen za sebe, ale za čest celé své země!

programme.title: Fantastický mazel
programme.desc: Ti je chudý stavební dělník, který se ze všech sil snaží udržet svého synka Dickyho na prestižní soukromé škole. Přestože Ti dělá co může, aby mu zajistil příležitosti, které sám nikdy neměl, Dicky si ve třídě připadá jako odstrkovaný a přehlížený outsider, protože nosí obnošené oblečení a na rozdíl od ostatních spolužáku nevlastní nejnovější elektronické hračky. Jednoho dne Ti najde na skládce tajemného "plyšáka" a spěchá s ním domů za Dickym. Přestože podivný chlupatý tvor na první pohled nevypadá jako obyčejná hračka, když si s ním chlapec začne hrát, ukáže se, že je mnohem, mnohem víc! Tohle není jen průměrná akční figurka, ale živý "mazel" oplývající výjimečnými schopnostmi. Dicky vezme veselého mimozemšťana do školy, aby ho ukázal spolužákům a konečně na ně udělal dojem. Jenže svéhlavý fantastický mazel má vlastní představy o zábavě a situace ve škole se záhy beznadějně vymkne kontrole...

programme.title: Le zap
programme.desc: Un zapping étonnant qui s'adresse à la génération qui a grandi avec une télécommande à portée de la main. Vidéos amateurs, people, passages télé... Internet fourmille de séquences toutes plus drôles, plus insolites, les unes que les autres. LE ZAP a ainsi déniché les plus belles chutes, des fous-rires mémorables, des performances étonnantes pour surprendre encore et encore. Détente et surprises sont au rendez-vous de ce programme pas comme les autres.

programme.title: Swann Périssé - Calme
programme.desc: Swann Périssé, n'a jamais été calme. Elle pensait que la sérénité arriverait avec l'âge, mais arrivée à 30 ans, elle a dû se rendre à l'évidence : elle a un problème avec la colère. Convaincue d'être la seule dans ce cas, elle a commencé à demander autour d'elle comment les autres géraient la leur. Les réponses étaient tellement déroutantes qu'elle a décidé d'en faire un spectacle.

programme.title: Elisabeth Buffet : Mes histoires de coeur
programme.desc: "Et si je vous parlais de mes aventures amoureuses et sexuelles ? Enfin, de mes ratages, sinon c'est pas drôle. Du Cap d'Agde à Pornic, des restaurants dans le noir à la thalasso en passant par des expériences surréalistes, retour sur mes échecs sentimentaux. Pour qu'on en rie !". Elisabeth Buffet, humoriste et actrice, invite à un voyage comique plein d'autodérision et d'observations tranchantes sur la vie moderne.

programme.desc: Capté à Québec dans le cadre du prestigieux festival "Juste pour rire", une sélection de talents émergents issus de l'ensemble de la francophonie offrent un aperçu de la relève humoristique.

programme.title: Les nouveaux visages : Juste pour rire 2ème édition - Saison 2
programme.desc: Capté à Québec dans le cadre du prestigieux festival "Juste pour rire", une sélection de talents émergents issus de l'ensemble de la francophonie offrent un aperçu de la relève humoristique.

programme.title: Kamel le magicien : Crois en tes rêves !
programme.desc: Dans son spectacle familial, Kamel le magicien propose un voyage intimiste où il se raconte et relate son histoire en émerveillant avec de nouveaux tours de magie pour le plus grand plaisir des plus petits comme des plus grands.

programme.title: Le grand show des humoristes
programme.desc: Ce rendez-vous réunit les plus grandes stars francophone de l'humour, et regroupe les moments les plus marquants du Festival Juste pour rire de Montréal. Pour le plus grand plaisir des téléspectateurs, les sketches cultes, parodies hilarantes et duos inédits formés spécialement pour l'occasion s'enchainent à un rythme rapide.

programme.title: Saturday Night Live
programme.desc: La présentation, le monologues et les sketches de Jalen Brunson, Dakota Johnson, Shane Gillis ou encore Inde Navarrette sont les temps forts de cette 52e saison du mythique rendez-vous humoristique "Saturday Night Live", agrémenté de nombreux numéros musicaux, notamment interprétés par Katseye, Turnstile, Rosalie, ou encore Gracie Abrams.

programme.title: Jamel Comedy Club
programme.desc: La 13e saison du Jamel Comedy Club est fidèle aux recettes des précédentes : des humoristes en devenir et déjà très talentueux, un esprit de troupe et un travail collectif, et des numéros de stand-up qui s'enchaînent sans temps morts. Sur la scène du club, les protégés de Jamel Debbouze assurent.

programme.title: Sur place ou à emporter ? - Saison 1
programme.desc: Décidés à réussir, l'un dans la gastronomie, l'autre dans le business, Boriss et Samy ouvrent un kebab dans leur ville. Malgré une débordante envie de bien faire et des idées à n'en plus finir, leur établissement ne rencontre pas le succès escompté. Accompagnés avec sarcasme par PV, client de la première heure, ils jonglent ensemble entre audace et échec.

programme.title: Sur place ou à emporter ? - Saison 1

programme.title: Philippe Bouvard : L'art d'en rire
programme.desc: Avec sa bonhommie et son insolence, Philippe Bouvard a fait rire la France entière pendant plus de 40 ans. Du Théâtre de Bouvard aux Grosses Têtes, de succès d'audience en éclosion de talents, cet homme de média a réussi à imposer son style inimitable dans le PAF. Ce documentaire est l'occasion de revivre ses moments cultes de télévision à travers des archives, des anecdotes inédites et les interviews des protagonistes.

programme.title: Le zap
programme.desc: Un zapping étonnant qui s'adresse à la génération qui a grandi avec une télécommande à portée de la main. Vidéos amateurs, people, passages télé... Internet fourmille de séquences toutes plus drôles, plus insolites, les unes que les autres. LE ZAP a ainsi déniché les plus belles chutes, des fous-rires mémorables, des performances étonnantes pour surprendre encore et encore. Détente et surprises sont au rendez-vous de ce programme pas comme les autres.

Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Una niña de seis años corrió y se escondió cuando vio que su abuela era golpeada hasta causarle la muerte, pero el hombre la siguió, la golpeó y la agredió. Ella dijo que el agresor era su tío, quien fue condenado. Se retractó de su testimonio años después.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un cirujano es apuñalado hasta la muerte y el sospechoso más probable es visto en un restaurante al momento del asesinato.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Dos sospechosos están vinculados a un asesinato por unas botas manchadas de sangre y una pistola, pero el dueño de los artículos dice que nunca conoció a la víctima.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 2006, Darlene Vander Giesen recibió correos electrónicos amenazantes y luego desapareció. Rastrear los correos electrónicos llevó a la policía a la casa de Daphne Wright, donde creen que se cometió un asesinato.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 2005, el cuerpo de la joven madre, Summer Baldwin, fue encontrado en una maleta en un vertedero de Texas.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Special Tribute
programme.desc: 25 anys després de la seva estrena, 'Forensic Files' segueix sent la sèrie de crims reals més exitosa de tots els temps.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Las mujeres en una ciudad de Louisiana viven con el temor de un violador que no deja pistas sobre su identidad. Pero la tecnología y la ciencia del comportamiento se combinan para brindar a la policía una nueva herramienta forense.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1987, la muerte de Crystal Purcell fue considerada un accidente. Luego en el 2001, Barbara Purcell llamó a la policía para sugerir que su desaparecido esposo había matado a Crystal.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Durante 15 meses, un asesino en serie estranguló a prostitutas en Florida y luego se burló de la policía dejando los cuerpos a la vista. Las únicas pistas fueron una huella de neumático y algunos hilos.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: La mejora digital del video de la cámara de seguridad muestra que lo que parece ser un encuentro casual es en realidad un secuestro forzado, que conduce al asesinato.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando se encuentra muerto al cirujano cardíaco Darryl Sutorius en el sótano de su lujosa casa de Cincinnati, la policía asume que se suicidó.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En este episodio clásico de Archivos Forenses la serie de crímenes reales más extensa de la historia de la televisión, Eileen y Derrick Severs desaparecen de su casa en un pequeño pueblo de Gran Bretaña y la policía encuentra evidencia de un crimen.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: La investigación del secuestro de la esposa de un prominente banquero llevó a la policía a una persecución inútil.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Una Bolsa de Evidencia

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Susie Mowbray fue acusada de la muerte de su esposo. Su hijo estaba tan convencido de su inocencia que se matriculó en la facultad de derecho, estudió todas las pruebas y, finalmente, descubrió la verdad de lo que realmente sucedió entre sus padres.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Condena por Huella de Palma de Mano
programme.sub-title: Condena por Huella de Palma de Mano

programme.title: Deadly Women: Married to Murder
programme.desc: To the outside world, their marriages seemed happy. But behind closed doors, there was no domestic bliss. These women wanted out, but getting a divorce wasn’t their preferred option.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: No one doubts a woman’s capacity to love, but sometimes lust can turn lethal. In the ultimate fatal attraction, "Deadly Women" looks at cases of murder driven by obsessive love.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Judi Buenoano secretly murdered lovers to claim on insurance policies whilst nurse Genene Jones secretly killed at least 46 infants left in her care between 1980 and 1982.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women never get their hands dirty: no blood touched them because they manipulate others to kill for them...but they didn't get away.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Under His Control
programme.desc: These are love stories with bleak, bloody endings. Blinded by desire, obsessed and malleable, some women fall into lethal relationships with dangerous, controlling men.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Blood ties are strong ties, sometimes strong enough to pull a person into a murderous conspiracy. When a family member wields his or her power, the result can be death.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Obsession
programme.desc: Deciphering what causes minds to corkscrew out of control is the complex work of the criminal profiler. Obsessions can take many forms: beauty, devotion, ego and power.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Love Gone Wrong
programme.desc: Love can be beautiful, love can be blind and love can be deadly. Desire and jealousy are powerful forces driving women to dark and horrifying places in their minds.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Teen Killers
programme.desc: They were too young to drink or vote but they were not too young to commit the most brutal of crimes. Some were driven by pure curiosity: how would it feel to take a life?

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Crimes of revenge are usually single acts of passion. A brew of hatred and restitution boils over in a manic moment of fury. Once caught, revenge killers usually display remorse and atonement.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The path towards revenge can sometimes lead to murder. It can be quick, fiery and violent. It can also be a dish served cold, the product of a calm, calculated plot.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women would stop at nothing to get their hands on the cash they needed. From husbands to strangers to other people’s babies, they spilt blood for money.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: A lovely lady with an innocent smile, kind eyes, a charming personality? No one would suspect a woman like that would murder. These women don’t look or behave like killers.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: While marriage is meant to be for life, it often ends in divorce. These wives took their marriages vow seriously: "till death do us part."

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Picture This
programme.desc: A fugitive with a long criminal record has fled to Hawaii, and the bondsman on the mainland has asked Dog for help. Dog doesn't have much information to work with, but he can use the felon's desire to impress his friends to track him down.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Tag, You're It
programme.desc: To his traditional bounty hunting tools of confidential informants, canvassing, and silver-tongued subterfuge the world's greatest bounty hunter has added Facebook! A word to the wise for those on the run-post at your own peril, the Dog is watching!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: A Family Affair
programme.desc: Dog likes to say, "The apple doesn't fall far from the tree," and this is a hunt where that is true. So will Dog be able to use one family member's troubled ways to catch another one in trouble with the law?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Training Day
programme.desc: While the team tries to handle the bond that newcomer Alysin wrote incorrectly, sparks are flying between Beth and Duane Lee when he questions Beth's decision to go on the hunt without Dog leading the charge!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Cutting the Apron Strings
programme.desc: Two different young men both have a bad habit of missing their court dates. Looking over their files Dog senses that they have another trait in common, both are a little too tied to their mothers.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Short Handed
programme.desc: Dog's target today has a history of violence, and apparently plans to re-locate without notifying the proper authorities. Unfortunately the team is missing a key player, Duane Lee is MIA today distracted by his new lady love.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Photo Op
programme.desc: Dog and Duane Lee can't agree about what role Duane Lee should have in the family business. But the family comes together as they set out to hunt a chronic violator with an open warrant and a wife who has an odd request for Dog.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: A House Divided
programme.desc: Dog has dropped Duane Lee from the team. When Leland confronts Dog and Beth about the decision tempers flare. But they have to come together to answer a cry for help from a mother who feels that the safest place for her daughter is jail.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: All Grown Up
programme.desc: Cecily has graduated from High School and Dog believes the time is right to show her what the family business is all about. The rough and tumble world of bounty hunting is very different than the all girls private school she attended.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Fight Like A Girl
programme.desc: This one is close to home. Dog's target on today's hunt is the cousin of Kali, Garry Boy's caregiver. In addition, she has a reputation as a brawler. With Duane Lee still missing from the team Baby Lyssa decides she will step-up in this hunt.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Higher Power
programme.desc: In an attempt to bring the team back together, Dog recruits his pastor, Tim Storey, to be the peacemaker. As Dog begins his hunt for a young man who has trouble showing up at court, Tim has his own mission - convince Duane Lee to meet with him.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Ties That Bind
programme.desc: With Duane Lee back on the team, the rift in the Chapman clan appears over. But will time heal this wound? As the family heads out for the seedier side of Honolulu in search of an erotic dancer, we will find out if the wound is truly healed.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Who's the Boss
programme.desc: When can a bounty hunt also be a date? When Dog and Beth decide to ride in the same SUV as they pursue a run away fugitive, will their different approaches to the investigation lead to a capture and romance?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bus Stop Bruiser
programme.desc: When an alleged abuser goes on the lame, Dog gathers the team to bring him in. As the leads grow colder Dog's determination only grows stronger. Finally, a hot lead comes in and Dog sets the trap for his prey.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Luck Be A Lady
programme.desc: Dog and company head to the Big Island in pursuit of two courthouse no-shows only to find that one of them appears to be posting status updates from Southern California.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Behind the Hunt
programme.desc: The cameras are turned around, as we get a tour of life "behind the scenes" on Dog the Bounty Hunter. Using interviews with Dog and the posse, the TV crew, and never before seen footage, this is one of most revealing and heartfelt episodes of the series.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: God Looks on the Heart
programme.desc: This fugitive spells trouble for Dog in today's hunt. When the leads grow cold it's the US Postal Service to the rescue as a mail carrier lends a helping hand. Dog's team surrounds the suspected safe house and silently awaits their prey.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Big Brother
programme.desc: Today's case involves a Samoan so Dog knows that the runner's close-knit kinfolk hold the keys to bringing him in. Dog's plan is to convince family that everyone is best served if the fugitive mans up and takes care of business.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Mid-Course Correction
programme.desc: Dog's target for today was once an upstanding member of his community. Now with no home, no job and the law on his trail, this middle-aged exile from middle-class society is using the cold end of an ice pipe to soothe his troubled soul.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Baby's Back in Town
programme.desc: Dog tries to nab a fugitive, named Wayne, by calling and telling him that he's won a new vacuum cleaner and he should stick around to get it. Dog then sends his daughter, Lyssa, to "deliver" the vacuum cleaner and lure Wayne out of his house.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Surprise! Surprise!
programme.desc: Dog and his team are out to revoke bail on Eugene, a chronic heroin addict. They find him in a squalid apartment with a huge stockpile of syringes, and they can see that his physical condition is deteriorating.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: No Ice in Paradise
programme.desc: Dog and his team fight the war on ice-crystal methamphetamine-on many fronts. They appear on a special anti-drug float in a parade. Then they go after bail-jumping Pana, a convicted drug dealer.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Fathers in Law
programme.desc: Hunting down a fugitive known as "Bozo," Dog gets help from an unexpected source, Bozo's father-in-law.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bosco the Clown
programme.desc: Dog and the team get a big surprise after they track down Bosco, a fugitive who they believe is addicted to methamphetamines. They discover he's off drugs, settling into a normal life with a new girlfriend, and is very friendly.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Leland has a full plate of fugitives in Kona, and the whole family heads to the Big Island to help.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Mama's Boys
programme.desc: Dog visits his mother's grave for inspiration before heading out to find Frankie, a violent fugitive hiding in the jungle. The spirit of Ma Chapman seems to help when Dog finds an unusual ally; Frankie's mother.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Lost in Paradise
programme.desc: Dog lectures high school students about the dangers of drugs before going after Joseph, a dangerous fugitive who won't be easy to capture.

programme.title: Tom Mabe
programme.desc: Tom has been profiled in People magazine, called "gut-busting hilarious" by The New York Times, and given a perfect 4-star rating by the New York Post. He's been featured on radio shows from Hollywood to Dollywood, including "Bob&Tom", Johnboy & Billy "BillHandel" and "Drew&Mike". Chances are you also know Tom as the star of CMT's hit comedy series, "Mabe in America", or have watched one of his popular viral videos. With more than 50-million views on YouTube, Tom is one of the most downloaded people on the planet. People love Tom's stories about coping with life's challenges, ranging from a child with a microscopic attention span to a family vacation in a minivan that takes a wrong turn. His original songs, stories, and videos make for a night out you will remember for years.

programme.title: Russ Nagel
programme.desc: Russ has become recognized in the entertainment industry for achieving more laughs per minute than any comedian working the circuit today and has also been seen on The Nashville Network, A&E's Comedy on the Road, Showtime's Comedy Club Network, the WB, Spike TV, Comedy Central and the list goes on and on. Being a 26+ year veteran of the comedy stage, Russ keeps the laughs coming fast and furious with an array of topics ranging from family and marriage, to travel and current events, and yes he even throws in some biker stuff too.

programme.title: Mountainbike: Cape Epic
programme.desc: S01E08 The Absa Cape Epic is the world's premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Andalucia Bike Race
programme.desc: The Andalucia Bike Race is Spain's premier mountain bike race, and one of the most outstanding in the world as recognized by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). Incorporating six stages over six days, the race weaves its way up and down the Andalucia mountains at a blistering pace, routing through spectacular trails and sensational views. Elite and masters race categories offer individual and team leader board standings, with daily stage prizes, overall medals and prize money for the elite UCI riders. The pace of the competition never slows across the six stages, kicking off with the stage 1 time trial; a short, fast and intense 'flash stage', featuring single tracks mixed with overtaking sections. Five days, 32 kilometres and over 6,590 meters of ascent later, the 57.8km "finisher" stage 6 is the final test, as riders climb over 1,396 meters up the mythical Reventón and pass through Trasierra, before descending and finishing along Santo Domingo's unforgettable single-track...

programme.desc: Mork haplessly gets involved with a group of white supremacists.

programme.desc: Fred confesses that he's having marital difficulties, so Mork and Mindy relay stories of their troubled times.

programme.sub-title: Putting the Ork Back In Mork (Part 2)

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Mork In Never-Never Land
programme.desc: With Mindy depressed about not getting a scholarship, it's up to Mork to stir up some laughs, so he brings home a friend who claims to be the real Peter Pan, with the power to fly as just one of his magical talents.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Mork, The Monkey's Uncle

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Mork's New Look
programme.desc: Mork sends the face-lifting business into orbit when he hilariously rushes to a plastic surgeon to shoot the works after Mindy gives Mork the idea that everyone could use a little improverrent on Mork & Mindy.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Mork and The Bum Rap

programme.title: Up in Flames 1936-1940
programme.desc: At the end of 1939, the German Army has invaded Poland. They are followed closely by the SS (Schutzstaffel) task forces, which have only one mission: To murder the Polish intelligence.

programme.title: The Gates of Hell 1941-1942
programme.desc: On June 22, 1941, Hitler invaded the Soviet Union. In the shadow of the war, Nazi regime gradually advances its "final solution to the Jewish problem".

programme.title: Genocide 1942-1944
programme.desc: Treblinka, Belzec Majdanek and Sobibor - the camps of "Operation Reinhardt," a Nazi murder campaign that took nearly two million lives within a few months in 1942/43.

programme.title: Armageddon 1943-1945
programme.desc: After the defeat of Stalingrad, the Nazis plan a kind of extended suicide on a global scale. Denunciations from the population ensure that the Gestapo can suppress almost any resistance.

programme.title: The Reckoning 1945-1948
programme.desc: After the war, winners and survivors want to hold the Germans responsible. The reckoning with National Socialism is ambivalent.

programme.title: UFOs and the Cold War

programme.title: Breakthrough in the East
programme.desc: January 28, 1945. World War II comes to Germany. Total war, in all its drama, strikes back at the Germans and reaches its climax on German soil.

programme.title: Germany in Ruins
programme.desc: March 6, 1945. Cologne is the first major German city to fall to the Allies. Stalin plans to conquer Berlin before the other Allies arrive.

programme.title: Downfall and Liberation
programme.desc: April 16, 1945. The Red Army begins its offensive on Berlin. The first concentration camps have been liberated by British and US forces, who discovered emaciated prisoners and corpses.

programme.title: The East
programme.desc: After the war, hunger and adversity shape daily life in East Germany. Many Berliners go to the countryside in search of food. In the city, a notorious gang of youths is up to no good.

programme.title: The West
programme.desc: Robbery, murder, rape. After the war, West Germany is the scene of brutal crimes. On the German-Belgian border, children risk their lives for something to eat.

programme.title: Crime in Post-War Germany
programme.desc: Germany, 1945. A nation faces up to the ruins of its past. Hunger and adversity shape daily life. What lengths did people go to? Over two episodes, Crime in Post-War Germany explores this transitional phase in German history by using the examples of individual, particularly serious criminal cases. Criminal psychologists and forensics experts go in search of traces.

programme.title: The D-Days Spies
programme.desc: Discover how agents tricked the Germans to keep their troops out of Normandy.

programme.title: The Soldier who never was

programme.title: The Spy who Saved the World
programme.desc: Discover how a Soviet Intelligence officer avoided WWIII.

programme.title: The A-Bomb Spies
programme.desc: Discover how and why several brilliant scientists divulged the secrets of the atomic bomb.

programme.title: Part 1
programme.desc: America and Europe in 1491, and why America was discovered and not the other way around.

programme.title: Part 2
programme.desc: The true legacy of Columbus is biological, and it created one world out of two.

programme.title: The Maya
programme.desc: More than 2000 years ago the Maya built gigantic cities in the middle of the jungle of Central America. They were brilliant inventors and set standards in writing, mathematics and astronomy.

programme.title: The Aztecs
programme.desc: The Aztecs: Within a very short time they created a huge empire, whose metropolis was a perfectly organized floating garden city on the Mexican plateau.

programme.title: The Incas
programme.desc: The Incas appear out of nowhere and within a few decades their empire develops into the largest empire in the world at the time.

programme.title: First Before Columbus
programme.desc: To many, Columbus is the man who discovered America. Yet, there had been others before him. This is their story!

programme.title: Heliopolis - The City of the Sun
programme.desc: A German-Egyptian team is looking for traces of the largest temple of the pharaohs in the middle of Cairo and for answers as to why the sanctuary was abandoned more than 2000 years ago.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Greeks Changed the World
programme.desc: Ancient Greece – the cradle of modern Europe. Around 3000 years ago, the cultural foundations of western civilisation were laid right here, on the shores of the Mediterranean. It’s the birthplace of democracy, where great thinkers forged the beginnings of scientific reasoning, where theatre was turned into mass entertainment, and where the Olympic Games began. Imaginative animation, stunning visuals and an entertaining narrative combine in an extraordinary exploration of Greece and the rise of an ancient super-power that would leave a permanent mark on western society.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Romans Changed the World
programme.desc: The Romans created one of the greatest empires in history, built with the help of an incredible army of professional legionnaires and a well-oiled political machinery. At its height, a few hundred men ruled over a fifth of mankind and an area stretching from Britain to Syria and from Gibraltar to the Euphrates. They undertook some of the most ambitious building projects of their time: endless roads, gigantic bridges and imposing aqueducts formed a complex infrastructure and left a lasting legacy. This film is a revelatory and unique journey into the world of ancient Rome.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Vikings Changed the World
programme.desc: This episode explores the Vikings not as ruthless raiders but as groundbreaking seafarers, traders, and explorers. Master shipbuilders, they forged vast networks of commerce stretching from Europe to Asia and even reached the shores of America centuries before Columbus. By challenging the stereotype of violent marauders, the documentary presents the Vikings as a tolerant and skilled people whose innovations in navigation and trade reshaped medieval exploration and left an enduring mark on global history.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 16 slams into Denver with the Welterweight World Title fight, the Heavyweight Contender Tournament, and the debut of USA Martial Arts sensation Pat Barry. Belgian striker Marc de Bonte will battle Armenia's technical machine Karapet Karapetyan for the vacant GLORY Welterweight World Title, guaranteeing a fast, explosive war. At the heaviest end of the GLORY ranks, the big-boys are set to battle it out for a higher ranked spot in the Heavyweight division, and a chance to fight for the Title later within the year. The lineup pits Errol "The Bonecrusher" Zimmerman versus "Bangin" Ben Edwards in a semi-final, and Sergei "The Paratrooper" Kharitonov vs. Anderson "Braddock" Silva in another semi-final. The tournament winner will have to win two fights in one night to claim the prize, and the right to fight for a bigger prize later in the year. Also at Heavyweight, in a tournament reserve match, MMA veteran Pat "HD" Barry returns to his original love of kickboxing, facing another GLORY debutant in the shape of Zack "The Black Warrior" Mwekassa.

programme.title: Return of Halleluja
programme.desc: In 1860s Mexico, General Ramirez hires American gunfighter Hallelujah to recover a stolen Aztec statue to win indigenous support. But a Scottish adventurer, feuding brothers, bandits, and the army are also in pursuit, turning the hunt into a chaotic race for power.

programme.title: Massacre At Grand Canyon
programme.desc: After a sheriff is murdered, his brother and fiancée fight to awaken a frightened town and stand up against a ruthless gang of hired gunmen. Justice, courage, and vengeance collide in a classic frontier showdown.

programme.title: The Son of Zorro
programme.desc: In imperial Mexico, Don Ricardo Villaverde leads a double life as the masked Son of Zorro, defending the oppressed from the cruel Governor Leblanche. When rebels ambush a weapons convoy and kill Don Herrera, his daughter Conchita is saved by Zorro, sparking a daring fight against tyranny.

programme.title: Django Kill... If You Live, Shoot!
programme.desc: Various factions, feud over stolen gold in a surreal town.

programme.title: Thunder at the Border
programme.desc: After a gang kills Apaches to steal their horses, Winnetou and his sister join forces with trapper Old Firehand. In the border town of Miramonte, they help defend the townspeople against the gang’s planned attack. As danger grows, Old Firehand also faces unexpected revelations about his former love and a long-hidden family secret.

programme.title: Scalps
programme.desc: The commander of a Texan fort in the Civil War refuses to surrender to the Northerners, and tries to buy the local Indian tribe chief's daughter. The sage man refuses, and the Southerners massacre the tribe and abduct the young squaw anyway. The noble squaw manages to escape, and hides out with a rough rancher, who dislikes Indians, but hates the Southerners more. The odd couple joins forces, and tactics, to exert ultimate vengeance on the men at the fort.

programme.title: Troublemakers
programme.desc: Two brothers who hate each other are going to spend Christmas with their mother. She tries to get them together.

programme.title: Secret of Captain O'Hara
programme.desc: Captain O’Hara saves Mary from Navajo warriors and brings her safely to Fort San Antonio. But her fiancé, Major Brooks, is not only O’Hara’s rival but also a ruthless enemy of the Native tribes. As tensions rise, O’Hara must fight for peace while facing personal betrayal and growing conflict.

programme.title: Deadly Trackers
programme.desc: Jeff sets out to murder each one of the five outlaws who robbed, raped and killed his poor sister.

programme.title: The Counterfeit Kid
programme.desc: Jack, a farmhand, accidentally impersonates the notorious outlaw "Bloody" Ben Harris. Now, on a treasure hunt, he must rely on a group of wild misfits to outsmart the outlaw he's pretending to be. With Harris hot on his trail, Jack must find the treasure and return to his true love, Olivia, before it’s too late.

programme.title: Paid in Blood
programme.desc: Jeff Cameron is Tom Carter and he’s a man on a mission to get revenge for his brother Jerry, who was gunned down after pulling his life savings out of the Rio Canyon town bank.

programme.title: The Magnificent Texan
programme.desc: Glenn Saxon, aka El Desperado, seeks justice for Mexicans and vengeance for his family. Orphaned by bandits, he targets the five men responsible, including outlaw Blackie Stark and Judge Wilkins. Amid schemes to control a wealthy daughter’s marriage, El Desperado maneuvers to make the guilty pay.

programme.title: iCarly: Das Nerd-Camp
programme.desc: Als Gibby einen Plan ausheckt, um Sam und Freddie zu trennen, deckt Mrs. Benson deren Beziehung auf. Wird sich Carly für Sam und Freddie einsetzen oder Gibby dabei helfen, sie auseinander zu bringen?

programme.title: iCarly: Zu dumm
programme.desc: Carly will ihren neuen Schwarm damit beeindrucken, indem sie sich schlauer gibt als sie eigentlich ist. Währenddessen hilft der Rest der Truppe T-Bo dabei, ein neues zu Hause zu finden, weil er aus dem 'Groovy Smoothie' geschmissen wurde.

programme.title: iCarly: Besuch der First Lady
programme.desc: Die Kids wollen Carlys Vater eine Online-Geburtstagsparty schmeißen. Doch als sie sich in ein gesichertes Netzwerk einhacken, bekommen sie Ärger von einer wichtigen Informationsagentur des Landes.

programme.title: iCarly: Psycho-Nora kehrt zurück – Teil 1
programme.desc: Die iCarly-Kids erfahren, dass Nora Dershlit aus dem Knast freikommen soll. Was können sie tun, damit ihre ehemalige Peinigerin hinter Gittern bleibt?

programme.title: iCarly: Psycho-Nora kehrt zurück – Teil 2
programme.desc: Die iCarly-Gang muss einen Weg finden, vor Nora und ihren verrückten Eltern zu fliehen.

programme.title: iCarly: Im Butterkuchen-Himmel
programme.desc: Alle außer Carly gehen zur Kanadischen Kuchenfabrik, doch Sam darf nicht wieder in die USA einreisen. Unterdessen macht sich Carly ausgehfertig für ein Date.

programme.title: iCarly: Oh weh, 3D!
programme.desc: Freddie will seine kreative Seite spielen lassen und entscheidet sich iCarly in 3D zu senden. Spencer stellt einen Assistenten an, den er nicht bezahlen kann.

programme.title: iCarly: Pleiten, Pech und noch mehr Patzer
programme.sub-title: Pleiten, Pech und noch mehr Patzer
programme.desc: Christopher Cane, der bei 'Victorious' den Charakter 'Rex' spielt, interviewt die Stars von iCarly und zeigt die besten Outtakes der Staffel.

programme.title: iCarly: Action mit One Direction
programme.desc: Nach einem Urlaub hat sich Carly eine ansteckende Krankheit eingefangen. Leider steckt sie ein Mitglied der Band One Direction an. Spencer soll mit einem kleinen Mädchen trainieren, das keine Lust hat Sport zu treiben.

programme.title: iCarly: Gibbys Traum
programme.desc: Mithilfe von Sam eröffnet Gibby im Keller der Schule ein geheimes Restaurant. Unterdessen designt Spencer einen Sicherheitsroboter fürs Loft. Doch der Roboter spielt plötzlich verrückt!

programme.title: iCarly: April, April ...
programme.desc: Es ist der 1. April! Carly und Spencer sollen aus ihrer Wohnung zwangsgeräumt werden, also teilen die Freunde ihre gemeinsamen Erlebnisse in der Wohnung. Doch wir erinnern uns etwas anders.

programme.title: iCarly: Plötzlich Verkäuferin
programme.desc: Freddies neuer Traumjob im Pear Store wird zum Albtraum sobald Sam auch angeheuert wird. Unterdessen will Carly, dass einer ihrer Kollegen sie nach einem Date fragt und Spencer muss bei der Freiwilligen Feuerwehr ehrenamtlich arbeiten.

programme.title: iCarly: Happy Hälft-o-ween!
programme.desc: Die iCarly-Gang schmeißt eine 'Hälft-o-ween' Party, weil Halloween so toll ist, dass es am besten zweimal im Jahr gefeiert werden sollte! Doch die Party gerät außer Kontrolle als ein kostümierter Gast Carly und ihren Freunden einen Streich spielt.

programme.title: iCarly: Chip, Chuck & Spencer
programme.desc: Gibbys neues Spielzeug geht kaputt, doch Freddie repariert es ihm und legt noch einen oben drauf. Spencer versucht einem rachsüchtigen Kind mit allen Mitteln das Handwerk zu legen.

programme.title: iCarly: Hausverbot
programme.desc: Carly verbietet T-Bo einen Fuß in die Wohnung zu setzen. Er revanchiert sich, indem er sie aus dem Groovy Smoothie verbannt. Freddie und Gibby entdecken die Vorzüge einer Band anzugehören. Doch Pflichten bringt es auch mit sich.

programme.title: iCarly: Ausflug nach Vegas
programme.desc: Als Sam erfährt, dass ihre Mutter in Las Vegas im Gefängnis sitzt, packt die Truppe ihre wertvollsten Sachen ein und verpfändet sie, um Geld für die Kaution aufzutreiben. Gastdarsteller: die Besetzung der History-Channel-Serie 'Die Drei vom Pfandhaus'.

programme.title: iCarly: Brave Mädchen, böse Mädchen
programme.desc: Sams Freundin wird aus dem Jugendgefängnis entlassen, und Sam rät allen, sich von ihr fernzuhalten. Doch Carly hört nicht auf sie und traut sich zu viel zu. Im Loft findet Spencer eine Nachtsichtbrille.

programme.title: iCarly: Gibby schockiert Amerika – Teil 1
programme.desc: Talkshow-Legende Jimmy Fallon lädt die Crew von iCarly ein, live in seiner Show in New York zu performen. Doch live auf Sendung schockiert Gibby durch ein Hosen-Missgeschick die ganze Welt und bringt beide Shows in große Schwierigkeiten.

programme.title: iCarly: Gibby schockiert Amerika – Teil 2
programme.desc: Talkshow-Legende Jimmy Fallon lädt die Crew von iCarly ein, live in seiner Show in New York zu performen. Doch live auf Sendung schockiert Gibby durch ein Hosen-Missgeschick die ganze Welt und bringt beide Shows in große Schwierigkeiten.

programme.title: iCarly: Freunde für Spencer
programme.desc: Die Truppe zieht los, um für Spencer Freunde in seinem Alter zu suchen. Sie finden schließlich ein paar vielversprechende Kandidaten. Aber werden sie auch wirklich zu Freunden?

programme.title: iCarly: Ciao Carly – Teil 1
programme.desc: Als Spencer an einem für Carly wichtigen Abend Fieber bekommt, versucht er, seine Krankheit vor ihr zu verstecken. Sam restauriert ein Motorrad, und Freddie bekommt ein peinliches neues Handy.

programme.title: iCarly: Ciao Carly – Teil 2
programme.desc: Carly hat sich gerade damit abgefunden, dass sie nicht zum Ball gehen wird, als ihr Vater plötzlich auftaucht, um mit ihr hinzugehen. Carlys Abend nimmt eine weitere unerwartete Wendung, als ihr Vater ihr eine lebensverändernde Frage stellt.

programme.title: iCarly: Miss Briggs sagt 'No!'
programme.desc: Mitgefangen, mitgehangen: Carly muss ausbaden, dass sich ihre beste Freundin und Banknachbarin Sam in der Schule mal wieder einen Streich erlaubt hat.

programme.title: iCarly: Eine leuchtende Idee
programme.desc: Carly hat die Idee, einen Wettstreit zu veranstalten und die Zuschauer online über den Sieger abstimmen zu lassen. Es geht darum, welches Team die beste Idee hat, wie man mehr Zuschauer für iCarly gewinnen kann.

programme.title: iCarly: Ein Schotte kommt selten allein
programme.desc: Carly und Co. fordern ihre treue Fangemeinde auf, ihre eigenen Tanz-Videoclips aufzunehmen und einzusenden. Die Reaktion ist überwältigend: In kürzester Zeit trudeln über 3.000 Videos ein – die natürlich alle gesichtet werden müssen.

programme.title: iCarly: Ein liebes Lied
programme.desc: Carly hat sich in einen Jungen aus der Schule verliebt. Weil sie ihn mag, lädt sie ihn dazu ein, in ihrer Webshow zu singen und Gitarre zu spielen. Leider merkt sie zu spät, welch ein schlechter Sänger Jake wirklich ist.

programme.title: iCarly: Das Großvaterdebakel
programme.desc: Carly und Spencer bekommen überraschend Besuch von ihrem Großvater. Er ist sehr besorgt darüber, dass Spencer nicht verantwortungsbewusst genug ist, um sich weiter um Carly zu kümmern. Carly und ihre Freunde versuchen das Gegenteil zu beweisen.

programme.title: iCarly: Nevel Supernerd
programme.desc: Carly und Co. bemühen sich darum, eine positive Kritik bei Nevelocity zu bekommen, einer Webseite, die über fünf Millionen Besucher pro Tag zu verzeichnet. Als sich Carly mit Nevel trifft, findet sie heraus, was für ein nerviger Junge er ist.

programme.title: iCarly: Absolut halloweenös!
programme.desc: Carly und Co. nehmen eine Show in einem alten Apartment auf, in dem es angeblich spukt. Als merkwürdige Dinge passieren, befürchten die Freunde, dass die Behauptungen über die Geisterwohnung wahr sein könnten.

programme.title: iCarly: Miss Briggs privat
programme.desc: Carly & Co. betätigen sich als Spione: Sie wollen herausfinden, was ihre Lehrer so in ihrer Freizeit tun - und die nichts ahnenden Pädagogen werden dabei für die iCarly-Website gefilmt!

programme.desc: In broad daylight on a busy Woolwich street on 22nd May 2013, serving soldier Fusilier Lee Rigby was attacked and murdered by Islamic extremists Michael Adebolajo and Michael Adebowale.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain
programme.desc: On 19 August 1987, Michael Ryan went on a bloody rampage in the village of Hungerford. Ryan shot and killed 16 people and his crime would change the face of Britain forever.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain
programme.desc: With her husband Fred, Rose West brutally murdered ten girls between 1973 and 1979, making her one of the most high profile serial killers in the UK.

programme.title: Cut To The Crime
programme.desc: Featuring hairdresser and host James Busby, well-known for his transformative online hairdressing content, contributors arrive at his salon and sit in the chair, just like in any hairdressers. While they have their hair washed, cut, dried, and styled, James nurtures them through a powerful, revealing and personally rewarding chat that allows them to share their story and the impact on them, their friends, their family and the wider public too.

programme.title: Britain's Darkest Taboos
programme.desc: The murder of gamekeeper Nigel Bacon is investigated. His wife Susan and his son Michael hired hit man Peter Jacques to murder him in a contract killing out of hatred and money.

programme.title: Britain's Darkest Taboos
programme.desc: Leanne Meecham was murdered in Southend-on-Sea in February 2014 by her abusive stepfather, Simon Meecham. Leanne’s sister Carly and her friend Alex tell us about their deep sense of loss and David and Emma look at what drove Meecham to murder.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI
programme.desc: En octubre de 1995, una familia de Carolina del Sur fue tomada de rehén como parte de un robo de banco bien planificado. La policía local rápidamente identificó a dos de los criminales, pero el autor demostró ser más evasivo.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI
programme.desc: En la Texas rural, una niña de trece años es secuestrada de camino a la escuela. Desesperado por encontrarla a salvo, su padre millonario contacta a las autoridades locales y al FBI.

programme.title: Cops en español
programme.desc: Los agentes capturan a un sospechoso y le salvan la vida. Un esposo reacciona mal cuando su esposa descubre sus actividades en internet. Un hombre agresivo lastima a todos a su alrededor.

programme.title: Cops en español
programme.desc: Un sospechoso intenta huir en el estacionamiento de un hotel. Agentes encuentran a dos hermanos peleando con cuchillos. Un revoltoso dispara su pistola de balines contra el hijo del vecino.

programme.title: Cops en español
programme.desc: Un sospechoso de robo es perseguido por oficiales. Después de dejar caer una bolsa de metanfetamina, un hombre jura no reconocerla. Un sospechoso de violencia doméstica dice que fue en defensa propia.

programme.title: Cops en español
programme.desc: La policía intenta desesperadamente de obtener la cooperación de un hombre desnudo. Después de una persecución, la policía descubre que el conductor es un niño. La policía tiene que lidiar con un problema de drogas y mentiras.

programme.title: Cops en español
programme.desc: Un sospechoso culpa a la novia porque descubren su crimen. Llaman a los agentes cuando la búsqueda de trabajo de una madre se descubre. La policía enfrenta a un hombre nervioso con malas mañas.

programme.title: Cops en español

programme.title: Cops en español

programme.title: Cops en español

programme.title: Los nuevos detectives

programme.title: Los nuevos detectives

programme.title: Los nuevos detectives

programme.title: Los nuevos detectives

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI

programme.title: м/с Рейнджер Лео и дикая природа ┊ 7
м/с Рейнджер Лео и дикая природа ┊ 8
м/с Томас и его друзья 17 ┊ 19
programme.desc: По серии книг «Железнодорожные серии» Уилберта Одри и Кристофера Одри. Паровозик Томас живет и работает в огромном депо на острове Содор. Томас с радостью выполняет разные поручения: подготавливает вагоны к долгому пути с большими паровозами, отгоняет пустые вагоны, чтобы освободить место. Он – настоящий трудоголик и следит за тем, чтобы коллеги не ленились. Его товарищ, заносчивый большой паровоз по имени Гордон, совершает длительные рейсы с пассажирскими и грузовыми вагонами, после которых любит вздремнуть. По причине своего характера он часто попадает в сложные ситуации, но на помощь ему приходят маленькие паровозы Томас и его друг Эдвард. Обязанности этих двух паровозиков очень похожи, но машинисты часто жалеют Эдварда, любящего перевозить людей, и разрешают ему тоже совершать рейсы с пассажирами. Он очень трудолюбивый и отлично справляется с любыми задачами, боясь не оправдать надежды взрослых. Генри – большой паровоз, обожающий свой зелено-красный цвет, поэтому больше всего на свете боится его испортить и поцарапать себя. Приключения постепенно сближают товарищей, и они становятся настоящими друзьями. Вместе они выполняют важные поручения и исследуют мир, доставляя вагоны во множество городов… Реж: Дэвид Миттон, Стив Эскуит, Грег Тирнан и другие, В ролях: Марк Мораган, Майкл Анджелис, Ринго Старр; Бен Смолл, Джон Хэслер, Мэтт Уилкинсон, Тереза Галлахер, Стивен Кинман, Найджел Пилкингтон, Боб Голдинг, Кит Уикхэм, Уильям Хоуп, Тим Уитнолл. Великобритания, 1984, приключения, комедия

programme.title: м/с Рейнджер Лео и дикая природа ┊ 56
м/с Робокар Поли и его друзья 2 ┊ 12
programme.desc: В небольшом городке Брумс бок о бок живут машины и люди. Полицейский автомобиль Робокар Поли трудится на местной спасательной станции. Его коллегами являются: Роботрак Рой, Робовэн Эмбер, Робокоптер Хэлли и девушка-диспетчер Джин. Робокар – лидер спасательной команды. Он любит патрулировать Брумс. Рой – пожарный грузовик, гроза огня и самый сильный в отряде. Благодаря сменному шасси он может выступать в роли подъёмного крана. Добрая и отзывчивая Эмбер – машина медицинской помощи, всегда подберет нужные слова, чтобы утешить и ободрить попавших в беду. Джин сообщает спасателям, где требуется их присутствие, а шустрый вертолёт Хэлли помогает координировать действия команды. В критических обстоятельствах Поли, Рой, Эмбэр и Хэлли умеют превращаться в роботов. В Брумсе возникают не только происшествия, но и различные проблемные ситуации, требующие вмешательства спасателей, а чтобы в дальнейшем инцидент не повторился, Поли и его друзья всегда готовы дать хороший совет. Реж: Джун Ён Ом, В ролях: Марк Томпсон, Айлин Стивенс, Кэйт Бристол, Ребекка Солер, Джейсон Гриффит, Джо Уайатт, Дэвид Уиллс, Майк Поллок, Лиза Ортис, Даррен Данстан, Сюзи Майерс, Джессика Пакет. Южная Корея, 2011, приключения
